rules.on_page: In all 28 'partly' verdicts the crop stopped short of the passage's end because the locator's end match was weak. The part shown was printed on the page in every case, so 'partly' counts as on the page, for the part checked.
rules.one_item: Yes when every printing carries the item the story's title names, even if some printings' matched text runs a little into the next paragraph. No when the shared text is a run of separate items (a digest), or when the story chains items so that some printings do not carry the titled item. Reports of one legislature's sittings printed as one continuing report count as one item.
rules.transcription: Fact-changing (major): a number, date or proper name read as a different plausible one; a word read as a different real word that changes the sense; words, a line, a signature or table data dropped or added. Minor: garbles a reader would recognise as errors, spelling or word-form variants, near-synonyms that keep the sense, silent corrections of printed misprints, and dropped or added small words that do not change the sense.
